name: Fishing and boat charter

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Gus and Ana (captains at the dock)

services.name: Private half-day inshore charter
services.story: The main story: a private half-day inshore charter for 4: $600, a $150 deposit when booking, the $450 rest paid at the dock before leaving.

services.name: Shared trip seat
services.story: A seat on a shared trip, $140, paid in full when booking.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Charter with dock pick-up
services.story: The main story: a full-day charter with dock pick-up: $675 ($600 plus the $75 pick-up). A $150 deposit when booking; the $525 rest charged to the saved card when the captain texts DONE.

services_shape: table: a boat booked for a set trip time by one group (a space with a passenger limit); a shared trip sells seats on a set departure (a seat in a session)
questions_before_times: a private boat, or a seat on a shared trip
how many people in all, adults and children (sets the price and must fit the boat's limit)
inshore or offshore, and the date
for a pick-up: the kind of place (a home dock or a hotel marina) and the town
safety_stop: someone overboard or a boat in trouble on the water right now
someone unwell right now: chest pain, trouble breathing, a bad fall
first_steps: each passenger's waiver on the secure page before the trip (a parent or guardian signs for a child), good for the season
the passenger list (names and a shore contact) on the secure page by 6pm the evening before
fishing licenses: where the boat's license doesn't cover its passengers, each angler who needs one buys it before the trip, and the number goes on the secure page
license: always, to carry paying passengers: each captain holds the federal captain's license for the boat's waters and passenger count (a 6-passenger license for an uninspected boat, a master's license for an inspected boat), with the drug-testing program and medical certificate it requires; the business holds any charter or fishing guide license where the state's rules require one; each boat has its own registration or federal documentation, and an inspected boat its certificate of inspection
staff_skills: which boats each captain may run; inshore, offshore, fly fishing
messages_never: passengers' health details, shore contacts, fishing license numbers and dates of birth: only on the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
